items.name: CodeGraph AST Intelligence Server
items.description: Pre-indexed AST code knowledge graph supporting 20+ languages. Auto-syncs on code changes. Targets Claude, Antigravity, Codex, Gemini, Cursor.
items.notes: Requires git repo + AST index to be pre-initialized (codegraph init). Non-portable without init step.

items.name: Gortex Multilingual Code Intelligence
items.description: Graph-based code intelligence supporting 257 languages. Fallback for codegraph on non-JS/TS repos.

items.name: Context7 Up-to-Date Documentation Server
items.description: Live up-to-date documentation and code samples for frameworks.

items.name: Playwright Browser Automation Server
items.description: Headless browser control, screenshot capture, and E2E validation.

items.name: GitHub API MCP Server
items.description: GitHub PR creation, issue tracking, and repository operations.

items.name: Ziplime Quantitative Backtesting MCP
items.description: Financial simulation, backtesting execution, and risk calculations.
items.notes: Package missing from environment. Install: pip install ziplime

items.name: Factory Central Memory MCP (28-Neuron)
items.description: 28-neuron central memory server: recall decisions, patterns, specs, ADRs. Verified live stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 server. Portable to any project directory.

items.name: MCP Memory Service (doobidoo)
items.description: [CANDIDATE] REST API + knowledge graph + autonomous consolidation (merges stale memories). Integrates with LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Claude. Autonomous consolidation matches factory Central Memory quality-control design.
items.evaluation_notes: Priority 1 candidate. Run full pipeline: license check → security scan (SSRF/auth audit) → sandbox → functional test. Benchmark README notes a dispute with MemPalace on LongMemEval — read full README before trusting any benchmark headline. SSRF risk rating: unknown until scanned.

items.name: MCP Memory (fellowgeek — Antigravity-compatible)
items.description: [CANDIDATE] SQLite + FTS5, Markdown+YAML OKF v0.2 on-disk memory. Explicitly targets Antigravity, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex. Human-browsable files: strong fit for factory provenance/auditability req.
items.evaluation_notes: Priority 2 candidate after doobidoo/mcp-memory-service. Local SQLite, no telemetry, no API calls — lower SSRF surface. Evaluate as fallback or complement (doobidoo for consolidation, fellowgeek for provenance).

items.name: Factory Architecture MCP
items.description: C1-C4 architecture model generation, Mermaid rendering, Draw.io XML, and drift detection.

items.name: Smart Context MCP (arrayo)
items.description: [CANDIDATE] Read/search/manage-context tools that compress instead of dumping full files. Reports up to 46x compression (89% token reduction on own project). Narrowly-scoped "targeted retrieval over full dumps."
items.evaluation_notes: Priority 1 context candidate. MIT license. Benchmark is self-reported (89% on own project) — validate with factory's own corpus before trusting numbers. No auth surface (read-only tools) → low SSRF exposure.

items.name: Factory Token Optimization MCP
items.description: Context deduplication, tool output compression (head/tail trimming), and token savings measurement. Fixed in Sept 2026 — compress_tool_output bug resolved.

items.name: Headroom MCP (log/trace/RAG compressor)
items.description: [CANDIDATE] MCP-layer compression for large logs, stack traces, file excerpts, RAG chunks, and agent handoff notes. Tools: headroom_compress, headroom_retrieve, headroom_stats. Complements RTK (CLI-layer) — they cover different token-bloat sources.
items.source: Referenced in Codex/Claude ecosystem alongside rtk-ai/rtk
items.evaluation_notes: Pair with rtk-ai/rtk (CLI layer) — current best-practice stack already uses both together. Confirm exact npm package name before install; referenced by description in ecosystem docs, not always by canonical package name. Run security scan before registering.

items.name: TOON Parse MCP (token-oriented notation)
items.description: [CANDIDATE] Strips code comments/redundant spacing, converts JSON/XML/YAML/CSV to compact TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation). Listed in official MCP Registry. Good for data-heavy tool outputs.
items.evaluation_notes: Register as specialized optimizer (not general-purpose). Narrow scope = low risk. In official MCP Registry = some baseline vetting. Still run factory security scan before activating.
